name: hover-border-gradient
title: Hover Border Gradient
blurb: Gradient border rotates around perimeter, flares on hover.
description: Wraps children in a border with a continuously rotating gradient that cycles through edges. On hover, the gradient animates to a bright central highlight. Driven by timer and mouse events.
use_when: A hero CTA that should stand out with subtle motion that settles on interaction.
avoid_when: Dense button groups where animated borders would cause visual chaos.
a11y: Wrapper only; focus and keyboard behaviour come from the child. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
